answer_1.quote: MetaAdaptRank transfers the relevance supervision signals from source domains to few-shot target domains in a zero-shot way. In this way, a natural language generation (NLG) model is trained on source domain relevance signals (Source-domain NLG Training) and is employed in target domains to synthesize weak supervision signals (Target-domain NLG Inference).

answer_2.quote: Following previous research , eight auto evaluation metrics are used in our evaluation.
